label: 抱膝坐姿
pose_lead: Grounded pose, seated hugging the knees:
lower_limbs: Both legs draw bent toward the chest, the feet together, the knees above the hips.
upper_limbs: Both arms wrap around the knees or shins, crossing in front of the legs.
torso_head: The back rounds slightly and the upper body tips a little backward; the head stays level.
weight_silhouette: The body closes into a compact ball; weight concentrates on the hips and the outline feels tightly sealed.
